# Validation status

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_validation_status.py from src/lilavati/validation_status.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Every engine has one status, and every MCP tool returns its engine's status in a `validation` field, so an agent can tell a checked engine from an unchecked one.

| Status | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| ✅ reference-checked | compared with an independent reference (paper, textbook or reference library) within a stated tolerance |
| 🟡 piloted on real data | checked against the real filings named on the validation page; a small pilot |
| ✅ rule-based | a fixed decision rule over reference-checked components |
| 🟡 not reference-checked | unit and property tests only; treat results as unvalidated |
